source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Network Topologies' (PDF 10): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: Network topology computer network ka layout (naqsha) hai. Yeh batati hai ke devices aur cables kaise arrange (tarteeb se lagaye) kiye gaye hain. Topology physical ya logical ho sakti hai. Physical topology asal connections (taarein aur jor) dikhati hai. Logical topology dikhati hai ke network mein data kaise flow (behta) karta hai. Topology network ki performance (kitna achha chalta hai) aur maintenance (dekh-bhaal) par asar dalti hai.

blocks.prompt: Physical aur logical topology mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Physical topology asal connections (cables aur jor) dikhati hai; logical topology dikhati hai ke data network mein kaise behta hai.

items: Topology: devices aur cables ka layout; physical (asal jor) ya logical (data ka bahao); performance aur maintenance par asar.
